summary: North kerb under big trees; homes 14-27 m away, cars park along the street.
reasons: Leafy tree cover on the north side

best_section.where: north kerb of Oxford Terrace under the large trees near the eastern end

drivers.seclusion: Dense houses within about 25 m both sides; nearest dwelling to the section is the bungalow 8 m off the line at 117 m, with others 15-27 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed residential street with cars parked along the kerb; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Through street linking junctions; moderate traffic.
drivers.convention: Several cars park along this kerb, so a van blends in.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign about 10 m from the kerb line, location not clear; probably near the west junction
Slope rises steeply along the full stretch (7.4% mean, up to 13%), but about 2.4% at the section
Toowong Creek 244 m away, low ground at the west end
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the section, mainly from the north side.
cannot_judge: Exact position of the No Stopping sign
